summary: A 1934 20-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab on the Coeur d'Alene National Forest, gone by 1960; no account of the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 20-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: The tower was gone by 1960; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in. The tower is gone.

events.note: 20-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab.
Gone by 1960. Idaho Fire Lookouts files the site as destroyed or removed.

evidence.quote: Photo courtesy the U.S. Forest Service

evidence.supports: location code 52N-1W-28 (no label on the page)

notes_for_editor: The record's L-4 design and 6.1 m height match the 20-foot L-4 tower on firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page. No source names a builder or any staff. The record photo links to idahofirelookouts.com; its 1946 date comes from the file name, not the page, so please check it. Firelookout.com says 'gone' and Idaho Fire Lookouts says 'destroyed or removed'; no source says which. No site description found.
